[See How](https://authentic8.com/partners/silo-marketplace/) × # Third Party Processors ## List of subprocessors To support the delivery of Silo services, Authentic8 uses service providers (each, a “subprocessor”) to store and process data. In most cases, processing (both by a particular subprocessor and at a particular location) is dependent on each customer organization’s configuration and usage of Silo. Authentic8 uses commercially reasonable efforts, in accordance with its established Supply Chain Risk Management program, to evaluate the data protection practices of its subprocessors.
